title: Bolts in back will scratch
text: Bolts in back will scratch. This basket has bolts permanently attached to the back where they will scratch against the cabinet door. It comes with additional screws with attached washers but no indication or directions on what might be the purpose; they do not fit in the same holes as the bolts. Also, despite their narrow construction, they will not work for narrow cabinet doors.

product_metadata.title: MaraFansie Grid Storage Basket, Cabinet Door Organizer, Wall Hanging Basket with Hook Over the Cabinet/Railing, Under Sink Kitchen Cabinet, Pantry, Bathroom, Small, Black, 4 Pack
features: 3 IN 1 STORAGE SOLUTION - MaraFansie grid storage basket with 3 IN 1 design that can be hung over the cabinet door with the hook, on a railing, and even mounted to the wall with nails. Great for most cabinets. Keep everything neat and easy to access.

MAXIMIZE SMALL SPACE - Create extra space to free up the countertop and cabinet. Perfect to use MaraFansie small hanging baskets in the kitchen, bathroom, pantry, craft room, office, closet, and entryway at home. Also great for RV and campers.

VISIBLE DESIGN - The open wire design achieves a good visual effect for quick access to make everything more convenient. The wire basket is finished in matt black that easily blends in with your home decor.

COMPACT & PRACTICAL - Package includes 4 small wire baskets(10.62" L X 3.94" W X 3.94" H), 4 hanging brackets and screws accessories. Made of sturdy steel that lasts. Measure your cabinets/handling space BEFORE to ensure the hanging length and the height suit your needs.

MULTI-FUNCTIONAL - A good storage solution for small items with our wall basket. Holds sponges and scrubbers within easy reach under the sink, ingredients in the kitchen wall, succulent plants, candles in the office, bath bombs or personal care items in the bathroom, etc. (NOTE: Holds supplies up to 8.5" tall)
WHAT IS IN THE BOX? - 4 Baskets, 4 Brackets, 8 Flat Head Screws (for bracket), 8 Self-Tapping Screws (for cabinet door mounting).
The door hook is approximately 1.3 inches wide. Fit in standard cabinet doors that are up to 1.22 inches thick. Please measure your cabinet door first.
